description.raw: '''Innate:''' '''Miss Fortune's''' [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals 50% – 100% (based on level) AD '''bonus''' physical damage, halved to 25% – 50% (based on level) AD against [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]].
description.text: Innate: Miss Fortune's basic attacks are empowered to apply a mark that expires upon attacking a new enemy. If the enemy was unmarked, this also deals 50% – 100% (based on level) AD bonus physical damage, halved to 25% – 50% (based on level) AD against minions.

notes.raw: * With [[File:Runaan's Hurricane item.png|20xpx|border|link=Runaan's Hurricane|An icon for the item Runaan's Hurricane]] [[Runaan's Hurricane]], ''Love Tap'' only applies to the primary target. * The bonus damage applies [[File:Life steal icon.svg|15px|link=Life steal]] [[Life steal|life steal]]. * The empowered attack will not trigger against [[buildings]].
